zero_gap_rule: zero_gap is true only when every gap is CLOSED with evidence at or above its exit level

gaps.summary: One machine truth must generate every current-state and traceability view.
acceptance: legacy global documents absent from the working tree
exact-head CI and independent review pass

gaps.summary: Protected integration must bind exact-head checks and a non-author approval.
acceptance: required checks pass on the exact integration head
approval is bound to that same head

gaps.summary: Reserve finite capacity before spawn and converge every post-spawn failure.
acceptance: concurrent starts stay within max jobs

gaps.summary: Prove parent-death, reader-before-writer and descendant cleanup on installed target.
acceptance: leader exit is not descendant absence

gaps.summary: Prove bounded output, exact cursor gaps and target reconnect behavior.
acceptance: zero stream credit does not block control

gaps.summary: Prove storage failure and corruption converge without false no-start claims.
acceptance: ENOSPC and fsync ambiguity are classified
recovery never performs blind effect replay

gaps.summary: Bind accepted, forwarded and terminal records to exact request ownership.
One install manifest must select the product entrypoint and internal children.
acceptance: foundation stubs are absent from product inventory

gaps.summary: Replace the single active effect request with bounded multi-inflight multiplexing.
Remove the global running-map lock from spawn and durability slow paths.
Replace the single-file single-lock write hotspot with indexed segmented durability.
Shard call and job registries without weakening per-key ordering.
Replace per-tool polling threads with event-driven cancellation and bounded event storage.
Establish repeatable mixed-workload throughput, latency, resource and recovery baselines.
acceptance: workload profiles WL-01 through WL-12 run
P50 P95 P99 and max recorded
CPU RSS FD thread process and I/O recorded

gaps.summary: Implement the mechanical global controller in observe and shadow modes before active control.
acceptance: leases include epoch expiry and fencing
controller outage preserves bounded local operation

gaps.summary: Qualify exact installed Codex bytes, identity and same-turn tool callbacks.
Bind installed UID, GID, namespaces, cgroups, mounts, stores and restart policy.
Build a clean Android graph with selected owner-open components and no legacy semantic nodes.
acceptance: Soong init SELinux and package inventory

gaps.summary: Prove ordinary ADB and visible effects on an authorized physical device.
acceptance: raw unauthorized offline and failure output

gaps.summary: Execute destructive crash, storage, disconnect, USB, reboot and power-loss cuts.
Bind signing, transparency, AVB, rollback, OTA, key custody and human release authorization.
